ledger.claim: The deviation is established on the only measurement POL-RD-01 allows. EV-GPS-02811 records trace_distance_km of 26.39 km against a platform optimal of 20.3 km stored on EV-TRIP-02811 — an excess of 6.09 km, or 30.0% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates are passed: the excess is greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km absolute. The trip record's rounded 26.4 km copy may not be cited for the threshold test, and on the governing trace figure the route deviation is ESTABLISHED.

The trace is clean and no corroboration burden arises. EV-GPS-02811 carries 207 fixes at a 10-second sample interval with 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0.0 seconds — well inside POL-RD-07's 90-second gap, 500-metre jump and 30-second interval limbs. The trace is therefore NOT impaired for policy purposes, the excess may be established on the trace alone, and no independent source is required.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. EV-TRIP-02811, EV-GPS-02811 and EV-FARE-02811 all carry trip identifier TRP-02811 and the same 06:32:18 trip start, and the excess of 6.09 km / 30.0% meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The rider's own profile does not add the special corroboration requirement: deviation_claims_60d on EV-RPROF-02811 is 1, below POL-RD-08's threshold of 4, so the claim does not need corroboration beyond the trace.

The refund is arithmetic, not discretionary. EV-FARE-02811 shows fare_model METERED and surge_multiplier 1.0, read from that artifact and not from the trip record. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 20.3 + 0.28 x 27.4) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 27.497, with no ERP, toll or surcharge lines and no waiting-time or promo adjustment. charged_total is 34.00. Refund = 34.00 - 27.497 = 6.503, rounded UP to SGD 6.55. That is 19.1% of charged_total, above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share, so the rider's outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.55.

No external-cause exoneration is open to the driver on this record. The only traffic advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02811-01, is MISSING — issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — with weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload, because no advisory covers the Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru corridor in this window. POL-RD-03's comparison therefore cannot be run, and any intimation of a closure, queue, breakdown or incident carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cites no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13(1) confirms the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than an escalation trigger, and the case is decided on the trace.

The chat log corroborates proximity, not distance. EV-CHAT-02811 shows the rider asked to 'stop at Jurong Point first', and the only trace corroboration in the record is that the vehicle passed within 21.7 m of the waypoint hint at 06:49:38. POL-RD-04 exonerates only the excess 'between leaving and rejoining the optimal corridor', and no artifact in this bundle measures that excursion — the applied optimal distance stays at the booked 20.3 km. Under POL-RD-08 the driver must point to a specific artifact and clause that actually discharges the excess; a chat request plus one proximity fix does not quantify any excused kilometre, so the measured excess of 6.09 km stands and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route.

The rider asked for the detour in writing: at 06:33:18 the rider sent 'can we stop at Jurong Point first, need to grab something'. That is a rider instruction, and it names a place specifically enough to act on, satisfying POL-RD-04(a) and POL-RD-04(c); the driver's 'ok' at 06:33:38 followed it.

The instruction was timely under POL-RD-04(b): it was sent at 06:33:18, sixty seconds after the meter started at 06:32:18, and well before the point at which the vehicle could have left the optimal corridor - in any event inside the three-minute allowance.

The gps_trace corroborates the requested stop exactly as POL-RD-04 demands: the vehicle's nearest fix to the Jurong Point waypoint hint is 21.7 m away, far inside the 200 m test, and the trace records that message as within_threshold.

Because the rider-requested stop is corroborated on the trace, the excess distance between leaving and rejoining the optimal corridor is excluded under POL-RD-04 before POL-RD-01 is applied. The chat log carries exactly one rider instruction (the Jurong Point stop) and the trace exactly one waypoint approach, at that same place; no artifact in the bundle evidences any other detour, so no excess remains once the requested stop is excluded and no deviation survives. The outcome is NO_ACTION and the metered charge stands.

Even on the POL-RD-08 frame the driver prevails: once the rider shows a 30% excess the burden shifts to the driver to point to a specific artifact and a specific clause, and the driver does so - EV-CHAT-02811 read with POL-RD-04 - which is precisely the discharge POL-RD-08 requires. A general assertion that the route was long would not discharge it; a recorded, trace-corroborated rider instruction does.

No repeat-deviation pattern is available against the driver under POL-RD-06: the excess here (30%, 6.09 km) does not even reach the materiality gate (50%, or 8.0 km absolute) that triggers the profile check, and in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1, below the threshold of 3, and 1 flag over 348 completed trips is 0.003, below the 0.05 ratio. Neither the POL-RD-06(b) uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) referral is in play.

The driver asserts no external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 is not invoked. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02811-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its absence neither supplies nor defeats the driver's POL-RD-04 defence.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you agree on the facts of the trip; you disagree about what the Jurong Point stop does to the fare.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The trip ran from Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru to Blk 610 Clementi West St 1 on 17 Aug 2026. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02811 (weight 1.0; 207 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s) measures 26.39 km against the platform optimal of 20.3 km on EV-TRIP-02811, an excess of 6.09 km, or 30.0% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates are passed (more than 20% of optimal AND more than 0.8 km absolute), so a deviation is established on the governing trace figure (the rounded 26.4 km copy on the trip record may not be used for this test). The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: no gap over 90 s, no jump over 500 m, no sampling interval over 30 s. The rider's profile does not add the POL-RD-08 corroboration requirement, because deviation_claims_60d on EV-RPROF-02811 is 1, below the threshold of 4.

THE RIDER-REQUESTED STOP (rider claims 1-3; driver claims 1-3, 5). At 06:33:18, sixty seconds after the meter started at 06:32:18 and before the vehicle could have left the optimal corridor, the rider sent MSG-02811-001 from EV-CHAT-02811: 'can we stop at Jurong Point first, need to grab something', carrying the platform-resolved waypoint hint for Jurong Point; the driver replied 'ok' at 06:33:38. The instruction therefore comes from the rider (POL-RD-04(a)), is timely, inside the three-minute allowance (POL-RD-04(b)), and names a place specifically enough to act on (POL-RD-04(c)). The GPS trace corroborates it on the test the clause actually specifies: the nearest fix to the waypoint hint is 21.7 m away, well inside the 200 m threshold (derived.waypoint_approach.within_threshold = true, using the waypoint_hint field and not any act of geocoding). POL-RD-04 is available, and the excess attributable to the rider-requested stop is excluded before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied.

THE RIDER'S QUANTUM OBJECTION (rider claim 6), REJECTED. The rider argues that POL-RD-04 excludes only the excess 'between leaving and rejoining the optimal corridor', that no artifact measures that excursion, and that the 6.09 km therefore stands. The clause places no separate quantification burden on the driver: the corroboration it requires is the 200 m field comparison, and that comparison passed. The chat log contains exactly one rider instruction and the trace exactly one waypoint approach, at that same place; no artifact in the bundle evidences any other detour. On this record the measured excess is the rider-requested stop, so once it is excluded no excess remains.

EFFECT. With the excess excluded, neither POL-RD-01 establishment gate is passed, no deviation survives, and POL-RD-02 does not run. The metered charge of SGD 34.00 on EV-FARE-02811 (fare_model METERED; surge_multiplier 1.0 read from the fare breakdown, the only artifact that carries the field) stands unchanged. POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION in that situation, and the rider's arithmetic refund claim (rider claim 4) is correct as arithmetic - recomputed_fare 27.497, refund 34.00 - 27.497 = 6.503, rounded up to 6.55 - but it is the calculation that would apply only if no exculpatory clause excused the excess, and POL-RD-04 does. No driver compensation arises under POL-RD-04's second limb: the rider was billed 26.4 km against a trace of 26.39 km, so there is no unbilled shortfall above 1.0 km.

OTHER CLAIMS. The driver's no-repeat-pattern point (driver claim 6) is correct but moot, since no deviation survives; in any event the deviation is not MATERIAL (30% is below 50%, and 6.09 km is below 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 profile check is not triggered and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02811-01 (status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is not relied on by either side as an external-cause ground - the driver asserts no closure, queue or incident - and its absence is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it, so it triggers no escalation under POL-RD-10(5) or POL-RD-13 (driver claim 7; rider claim 5). No other POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers all match, timestamps do not disagree by more than 10 minutes and do not run backwards, the trace is unimpaired, and there are no ERP lines, no airport surcharge and no unmatched charge line (off-route ERP total 0.00). No referral is produced by any clause.

CONFIDENCE. The facts this ruling rests on are carried by EV-CHAT-02811, EV-GPS-02811 and EV-TRIP-02811 - independent artifacts, each at weight_multiplier 1.0 - so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0, and my confidence is 0.80. No artifact below weight 1.0 carries the finding. The monetary effect is nil, so nothing is executed under POL-GEN-05, and payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 is left as it is. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04, and either may ask for a human decision under POL-GEN-08(3). Any open question about how a future case should quantify a rider-requested excursion is a matter for the policy-gap procedure, not for this ruling.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
